name: What is the typical cost range for a playroom addition?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a playroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a playroom addition varies widely depending on size, finishes, and features like built-in storage or custom play structures. Basic additions might start around $20,000 to $40,000, while larger, more customized projects with high-end materials can exceed $70,000. Practical tradeoffs involve balancing your budget with desired amenities; for instance, opting for standard windows instead of large custom ones can significantly reduce costs. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation to understand your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Playroom addition costs typically range from $20,000 to over $70,000, depending on size, finishes, and custom features. Budget and desired amenities are practical tradeoffs.
